verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents official client libraries/SDKs (e.g. 'client library installed and configured' triggers automatic error reporting) plus a full REST API for reporting exceptions, source maps, and deployments, and a dedicated CLI tool, all of which let developers build against official tooling. However, the evidence never enumerates specific supported languages/frameworks beyond incidental mentions (Ruby, Elixir/Oban), there's no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probe confirms 404s), and no independent hands-on validation of SDK quality beyond general product praise. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported language SDKs, OpenAPI/spec for programmatic discovery, and independent developer feedback specifically on SDK ergonomics.
